entities.name: Pierre-Paul Prud'hon
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pierre-Paul Prud'hon was a French Neo-classical painter and draughtsman best known in his own time for his allegorical paintings and portraits, now for his drawings. He painted a portrait of both of Napoleon's two wives.
